Method of Attack: Encrypts data with AES-256 encryption and demands $400 USD in iTunes Gift Cards as ransom
Places main executable at %APPDATA%\Windows\svchost.exe and creates autorun called Microsoft
Encrypts certain file types on SystemDrive in Desktop, My Pictures, and Cookies folders
Encrypts all files on other fixed disks including executables
Creates ransom notes named Read Me (How Decrypt) !!!!.txt in each folder with encrypted files
Uses iTunes Gift Cards as payment method
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with SystemDrive (usually C:) and other fixed disks
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text demanding $400 in iTunes Gift Cards
Email addresses for payment: criptote@hmamail.com, referas@hmamail.com, terder@hmamail.com, utera@hmamail.com, criptotak@hmamail.com
Ransom note file name: Read Me (How Decrypt) !!!!.txt
